method: Local only. Cached lowercased title+abstract and joined CPC/IPC/FI codes to work/txt.parquet. Per case: translated idea to patent vocabulary, ran weighted regex scoring in DuckDB (with code-group or must-match term filters), grouped by family_id, read the top abstracts by hand, and picked the best candidates in order. The rest of the 50 interleaves keyword hits (2 per step) with embedding_v1 cosine neighbours of the #1 pick (1 per step), one publication per family. When a first pass missed, I tried other wordings (e.g. 'supersonic' for ultrasonic, 'reference state'/'leftward' for steering), title-only rows and embedding expansion from partial matches.

problems: Empty abstracts are stored as '' rather than NULL, so the first noabs flag was wrong. Fixed by rebuilding the cache.
Rows with an empty embedding_v1 broke list_cosine_similarity. Filtered with len(embedding_v1)=64.
Machine-translated wording ('supersonic' for ultrasonic, 'reference state' for centre position) hid cases 05 and 07 from the first keyword passes.
Ranks 2-50 are padded with keyword and embedding neighbours. They are prior-art-style candidates, not curated.
